_doc: 16 KB page-size policy for every built APK (cloud-android-page-size-guard.py, run by the MANAGED-PAGE-SIZE-GUARD step that cloud-android-ship-repo-workflow-engine.sh injects into each ship-*.yml right before its APK upload, after the guard's own mutation test). Every lib/<abi>/*.so of the ABIs below must have PT_LOAD p_align >= min_align, and be STORED at a min_align-aligned zip offset (zipalign -c -P 16 -v 4) unless its app is listed under legacy_packaging. Added after the phone flagged cloud-drive (libaums' libusb-lib.so / liberrno-lib.so, 4 KB LOAD segments). Keys are the ship's WORK_DIR.
_doc_legacy_packaging: Apps that extract their native libraries ON PURPOSE (useLegacyPackaging=true, so the manifest gets extractNativeLibs=true), with the reason. Only the zip half is skipped for them; their ELF alignment is still enforced.

legacy_packaging.ac_cloud-termux: execs its tools (libtermux*.so) out of nativeLibraryDir, which must exist on disk (app/build.gradle packagingOptions)
legacy_packaging.ac_cloud-nix-on-droid: same exec-from-nativeLibraryDir model as cloud-termux (app/build.gradle packagingOptions)
legacy_packaging.ab_cloud-libs-shared/lib-apks: the exec flavors (rclone, unison, gh) set useLegacyPackaging in androidComponents so the engine binaries are on disk to exec
legacy_packaging.ac_cloud-c3-webserver: the native app (src-tauri/gen/android, #1682) sets useLegacyPackaging to keep the APK at its compressed size
legacy_packaging.ac_cloud-media-center: Tauri gen/android sets useLegacyPackaging to keep the APK at its compressed size
legacy_packaging.ac_cloud-code: the Cordova hook hooks/post-process.js enableLegacyJni() writes useLegacyPackaging = true

_doc_exempt_libs: Per WORK_DIR, per APK entry: a library measured 4 KB-aligned on 2026-11-01 (the fleet's 'latest' release, scanned entry by entry) that this change does not rebuild, with the reason. Each one is a follow-up, not a permanent pass; a NEW 4 KB library anywhere still fails. Empty is the goal.
